entry.title: Is functional food killing low carb – or absorbing it?
entry.summary: The functional food boom has changed how consumers see health and wellness. Low carb as a trend has not declined, but it has changed, being folded into the wider functional space. Restrictive diets such as Paleo have declined.

entry.title: Beyond Meat launches energy drink
entry.summary: Beyond Meat has continued its diversification by launching an energy drink, Beyond Immerse Protein + Energy. The drink is a caffeinated version of its high protein drink Beyond Immerse.

entry.title: Nestlé commits $1bn to North America expansion strategy
entry.summary: Nestlé is investing $1bn in Mexico, as it expands production capacity, strengthens agricultural supply chains and accelerates its North American growth strategy.

entry.title: APAC cocoa trends: ‘Worst is past’, but risks remain
entry.summary: Cocoa giant Barry Callebaut says the worst of the cocoa crisis is likely over, but the APAC cocoa industry continues to navigate major market shifts and challenges

entry.title: Better Dairy self-affirms GRAS status for lactopontin
entry.summary: Better Dairy has self-affirmed GRAS status for precision-fermented lactopontin, paving the way for US nutrition and supplement product launches.

entry.title: As consumers rethink fat, whole milk gets a second look
entry.summary: A growing focus on protein, satiety and whole-food nutrition is fueling renewed consumer interest in full-fat dairy, particularly whole milk.

entry.title: New data platform reveals opportunities for dairy milk to win back shelf space
entry.summary: MilkPEP’s new Milkscape platform uses AI and market data to help dairy processors and retailers spot consumer trends, drive milk innovation and grow sales.

entry.title: Can plant proteins help ease the whey squeeze?
entry.summary: Whey prices remain more than double year-ago levels. Explore how ADM and other ingredient suppliers are using plant proteins and hybrid formulations to meet demand.

entry.title: Creamers move beyond coffee with flavors, cold foams and café-inspired experiences
entry.summary: SPINS data shows consumers gravitating toward flavored creamers and cold foams that deliver café-inspired flavors and textures, while dairy-focused brands balance indulgence with simpler ingredient lists.

entry.title: Danone’s AI commerce goal: ‘Trusted by machines and desired by humans’
entry.summary: Danone wants its brands to be trusted by AI shopping agents and desired by consumers. Arthur Sylvestre explains the digital strategy behind that goal.

entry.title: Dairy’s fight for growth and shelf space
entry.summary: Explore dairy innovation trends, from high-protein products and plant-based competition to creamers, milk market insights and AI-powered commerce.

entry.title: Forget breakfast: The battle for the morning snack is on
entry.summary: Morning snacking is emerging as a distinct eating occasion, creating new opportunities for breakfast, confectionery and functional food brands. Discover the trends, ingredients and formats shaping the growing mid-morning market.

entry.title: Mars’ analysis reveals where retail emissions add up
entry.summary: As retail becomes more technology-driven, Mars sees ecommerce and consolidated delivery networks as materially less carbon-intensive than traditional store-based shopping.

entry.title: 4 strategies Coca-Cola, PepsiCo, Spindrift and others are using to revitalize RTD tea
entry.summary: With US RTD tea sales falling, Coca-Cola, PepsiCo and other brands are betting on zero sugar, bold flavors, functional benefits and premium ingredients to revive growth.

entry.title: 10 big ingredients concentrated in a single region

entry.title: Chocolate has a new problem. And it’s not cocoa prices
